hypothesis: A bounded result audit can accept or reject the M2508 runtime report without turning local actor timings into performance or validation claims.
success_criteria: audit verifies M2508 summary status_pass true and result_class pass
audit verifies runtime_measurements.csv has expected rows and positive timing values
audit verifies actor/action contract 72/3 human_view_online_gru horizon 1
audit verifies false flags for environment rollout simulation training ranking winner success-rate performance validation and paper claims
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution environment rollout training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2509 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2509 changes actor input or action contract
M2509 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2509 steps an environment or treats timing as policy rollout
M2509 treats runtime measurements as driver performance
M2509 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2509 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2509 passes if it audits the runtime report artifacts and confirms contract, measurement rows, timing validity, and false claim flags without external simulation, environment rollout, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
